_comment: TPC-only calibration runs with a Ba-133 source (2017-12-19/20), for the TPC gain map
{tpc_caldata} is replaced by the directory of the runs: $SMILE2P_TPC_CALDATA, else ~/smile2p_data/TPC_caldata,
else the server directory. Place the runs as <tpc_caldata>/20171219/Per01_TPC etc.
Each run is processed separately with --set ReadData.data_dir={tpc_caldata}/<run>.

RawTreeWriter._save_threshold: waveforms whose maximum is <= baseline + 10 ADU are not stored: any charge threshold >= 10 can be used afterwards

_runs: each run irradiates one anode board x one cathode board (empty 0-byte files for the others), except 20171219/Per01 and 20171220/Per06 (all boards)
